title: Awesome Opencode Entry
description: Schema for validating YAML entries in the Heretek-AI/awesome-opencode list. Cross-entry rules (unique repos, kind per category, compat for plugins) live in scripts/utils/catalog.js.

name.description: Display name of the project or tool

repo.description: Repository root URL (no /tree/ or /blob/ paths, no npm or marketing pages). Gists and GitHub discussions (for guides) are also accepted. Use `path` for a package inside a monorepo.

path.description: Subdirectory of `repo` that holds this entry, for monorepos (e.g. packages/my-plugin)

npm.description: npm package name, for entries installed from npm. Used for the V2 compatibility check and health checks.

homepage.description: Documentation URL if different from repository

tagline.description: Short punchy summary (shown in collapsed view)

description.description: Full description of the project (shown when expanded)

kind.description: What the entry is. plugin: OpenCode plugin package. theme: color theme. agent: agent/subagent configuration. skill: SKILL.md pack. mcp-server: Model Context Protocol server. client: GUI, TUI, web, mobile, editor or chat front-end for OpenCode. tool: CLI, proxy, library or other utility. config: starter config, commands or templates. guide: docs, tutorials or articles. fork: a modified build of OpenCode.

also.description: Secondary kinds, e.g. a plugin that also ships an MCP server. Cross-listed in the README and site.

topics.description: 1-3 use-case topics from a fixed list. The first one is the primary topic used for README grouping.

compat.description: OpenCode API generation. v2: depends on @opencode/* (e.g. @opencode/plugin with Plugin.define). v1: legacy @opencode-ai/* only. n/a: does not use the plugin/SDK API. unknown: not yet verified. Required for plugins; CI verifies it.

scope.description: Installation scope: global (~/.config/opencode/) or project (.opencode/). Defaults to [global] if omitted.

tags.description: Free-form search keywords. Not rendered; use `topics` for categorization.

min_version.description: Minimum OpenCode version required (semver format, e.g. '2.0.0')

installation.description: Detailed installation instructions in markdown format
